checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: First ~5s close-up of coffee pouring into ceramic cup
must.why: Frame 1 shows a clear pour into a white ceramic cup. By 3.2s the pour has stopped and the cup is steaming, but the shot is still a coffee close-up.
Frames at 5.6s and 7.6s are black with only the text.

must.item: End card reads exactly the URL
must.why: It reads 'httpsxamacom/Gef:June.' with missing characters, and the 'G' and 'ref' are wrong.

must.item: URL centered in white on one line, fully inside frame, readable
must.why: The text is white, on one line and centered. It is garbled, so it is not the requested URL.
No other text is visible in the sampled frames.
The frames are 480x854 and the clip is 8s. Silence was reported, not verified.

faults.what: The URL is garbled: the colon and slashes after https, 'example', 'Go', '?ref=' are missing or wrong.
A trailing period was added after 'June', which the user explicitly forbade.
The pour has already ended by 3.2s, so it is not shown pouring for the full 5s.

summary: The coffee pour shot looks good and the black end card is right, but the URL is garbled ('httpsxamacom/Gef:June.') with a trailing period, so the clip fails its main requirement.
